'''Coilwood''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that could be found on [[Vryssa]].<ref name="Journal14">{{JournalCite|14|No Disintegrations, Please}}</ref>

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Coilwood appeared in a flashback in "[[No Disintegrations, Please]]," a short story by [[Paul Danner]] that was published in the [[August]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|fourteenth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Journal14" />
